description: Add a Demo navigation link to the Navbar component

userStories.title: Add Demo link to Navbar navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a Demo link in the navigation bar so that I can navigate to the demo page.
acceptanceCriteria: Open src/components/Navbar.jsx and locate the navigation list containing Home and Hello World links
Add a new list item with <Link to='/demo'>Demo</Link> (or NavLink if that pattern is used) after the Hello World link
Ensure Link or NavLink is imported from react-router-dom at the top of the file; add the import if missing
Existing Home and Hello World navigation links are not removed or altered
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
